## Overview

### Product Information on Bonusly

Updated 13th October 2025

#### What is Bonusly?

Bonusly is an employee recognition software designed to facilitate peer-to-peer recognition and reward within organizations. The software enables employees to give each other points for contributions, which can be redeemed for a variety of rewards. It offers features such as integration with communication tools, real-time recognition, detailed analytics, and customizable reward catalogs. Bonusly is used by organizations to support employee engagement, promote workplace collaboration, and reinforce company values.
The platform helps businesses address the challenge of retaining talent and building a positive organizational culture by making recognition accessible and measurable across teams.

#### Bonusly Pricing

The Bonusly software utilizes a subscription-based pricing model with tiered plans based on the number of users and features required. Billing occurs on a monthly or annual basis, and available features may differ by plan level. The software provides different options according to organizational needs with pricing adjusted for team size and selected functionalities.

# Bonusly launches Bizy, an AI agent that helps teams connect and grow together again

Provided by PR Newswire Aug 13, 2026, 7:00:00 PM

Bonusly launches Bizy, an AI agent that helps teams connect and grow together again ## Bonusly launches Bizy, an AI agent that helps teams connect and grow together again PR Newswire BOULDER, Colo., Aug.
13, 2026 _As AI reshapes daily work, threatening authentic employee engagement, Bizy helps teams find moments to recognize one another._ BOULDER, Colo. , Aug. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- [Bonusly](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4751201-1&h=1558705946&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbonusly.com%2F&a=Bonusly) , the recognition and rewards platform used by more than 3,400 companies, today announced the launch of Bizy, an AI agent that finds the recognition moments teams miss and brings them back into view, so employees can connect with each other, recognize wins, and participate actively in company culture. Bizy works in the areas where company culture stops: the gaps between different systems, offices, and projects. It connects to the tools teams work in, including project management, chat, and Bonusly itself, and proactively notices people worth recognizing.
It runs as a standing agent rather than a chatbot, continuously reading activity across tools, scoring data for recognition signals, and drafting recommendations on its own, no prompt required. The launch comes at a hard moment in the global workforce. According to Workday's 2026 Human Connection Workplace Index, 43% of employees said reduced human interaction was their biggest worry about AI, ahead of job loss. A third of respondents rarely or never have a conversation with a colleague that goes beyond a work task in a given week. Bizy is built on the opposite premise, and instead uses AI to recommend co-workers to connect with and surface recognition opportunities based on culture data. As some AI narrows work down to a single person and a single screen, Bizy widens it back out to the team. "The world of work is changing fast, and most companies are chasing AI without asking who it's for," said Charles Hough, CEO of Bonusly.

_As AI reshapes daily work, threatening authentic employee engagement, Bizy helps teams find moments to recognize one another._

BOULDER, Colo. , Aug. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- [Bonusly](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4751201-1&h=1558705946&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbonusly.com%2F&a=Bonusly) , the recognition and rewards platform used by more than 3,400 companies, today announced the launch of Bizy, an AI agent that finds the recognition moments teams miss and brings them back into view, so employees can connect with each other, recognize wins, and participate actively in company culture.
Bizy works in the areas where company culture stops: the gaps between different systems, offices, and projects. It connects to the tools teams work in, including project management, chat, and Bonusly itself, and proactively notices people worth recognizing. It runs as a standing agent rather than a chatbot, continuously reading activity across tools, scoring data for recognition signals, and drafting recommendations on its own, no prompt required.

The launch comes at a hard moment in the global workforce. According to Workday's 2026 Human Connection Workplace Index, 43% of employees said reduced human interaction was their biggest worry about AI, ahead of job loss. A third of respondents rarely or never have a conversation with a colleague that goes beyond a work task in a given week.

Bizy is built on the opposite premise, and instead uses AI to recommend co-workers to connect with and surface recognition opportunities based on culture data.
